title: GisLayerDocument
description: MongoDB `gis_layers` collection document — one per named boundary/constraint layer, seeded by scripts/seed-gis-layers.js. Unique index on layer_name; 2dsphere index on geometry_full. §67.1, §99.5. constraint_type enum kept identical to api/MapLayersResponse.json's layers[].constraint_type.

geometry_full.description: Full-resolution GeoJSON, used server-side for $geoIntersects geofence checks. §66.2

geometry_simplified.description: Simplified geometry served via GET /api/v1/map/layers for display. §67.1
